display.title: The Power of a Chassidic Farbrengen, Part 1: A Blessing for Healing
display.summary_short: For the month of Kislev, a story from the Frierdiker Rebbe: Chassidim at a farbrengen bless a gravely ill friend, and he lives forty more years. Then the history of the Alter Rebbe's portrait.
display.summary_long: The storyteller explains why the Rebbe asks for many Chassidic farbrengens in the month of Kislev, and shares the first of two stories told by the Frierdiker Rebbe. In the years when the Alter Rebbe still traveled to learn from Rabbi Menachem Mendel of Horodok, the students sat together at a farbrengen. A Chassid whom the doctors had given up on stood up in tears and begged his friends for a blessing. Some laughed that simple people cannot bless, and a nigun did not calm him. Then the Alter Rebbe reminded them of the note from Heaven: what a Chassidic farbrengen can accomplish, even the angel Michael cannot. Together, with love for one another, they blessed him, and he lived more than forty years longer. The Alter Rebbe explained with a parable of a father whose quarrelsome children learn to love each other, so that he grants all their wishes. Along the way the storyteller teaches that a doctor's job is to heal, not to predict how long someone will live. The piece ends with the story of the Alter Rebbe's portrait, drawn while he was in prison, studied by the Tzemach Tzedek and later printed by his great-great-grandson, setting up the second story.
display.lesson: When Yidden gather with love and care for one another, Hashem grants their requests; to receive Hashem's blessings, help others.

segments.title: Farbrengens in the month of Kislev
segments.summary: The Rebbe asks for many Chassidic farbrengens in Kislev, and two stories from the Frierdiker Rebbe show why.

segments.title: The blessing at the farbrengen
segments.summary: The Alter Rebbe reminds his friends of the power of a farbrengen, and their blessing heals a gravely ill Chassid.

segments.title: The Alter Rebbe's parable of the father and his children
segments.summary: When Hashem sees His children caring for each other, He grants their requests, like a father delighted by his children's good midos.

segments.title: The story of the Alter Rebbe's portrait
segments.summary: The portrait drawn during the Alter Rebbe's imprisonment, studied by the Tzemach Tzedek and later printed by a descendant.
